title: Prospectus: register Babulus as a product
description: Cross-repo dependency (AnthusAI/Prospectus). Product registration is hard-coded today (infra/lib/accounts-plane.ts for Cyclotron, accounts/papyrus-sites.json for Papyrus sites); there is no generic registry yet (Prospectus kanbus-bf45cb). Needed: a reviewed `babulus` registration with its IAM runtime role in account 869507387405, Cognito issuer/client, capabilities and route allow-list, and whether it may create accounts. Each piece needs Ryan's action-time approval per Prospectus docs/OPERATIONS.md. File the matching issue on the Prospectus board and coordinate with the Prospectus session. Depends on the integration-choices task.
